# Data Source: stripe_billing_meter

Defines how usage events are aggregated into a billable quantity. `terraform destroy` deactivates the meter, because Stripe cannot delete one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_billing_meter" "api_calls" {
  id = stripe_billing_meter.api_calls.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

Exactly one must be set.

* `id` - (Optional) Unique identifier for the object.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `customer_mapping` - Fields that specify how to map a meter event to a customer. See [`customer_mapping`](#customer_mapping) below.
* `default_aggregation` - The default settings to aggregate a meter's events with. See [`default_aggregation`](#default_aggregation) below.
* `display_name` - The meter’s name. Not visible to the customer.
* `event_name` - The name of the meter event to record usage for. Corresponds with the `event_name` field on meter events.
* `event_time_window` - The time window which meter events have been pre-aggregated for, if any. Possible values: `day`, `hour`.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `status` - The meter's status. Possible values: `active`, `inactive`.
* `status_transitions` - See [`status_transitions`](#status_transitions) below.
* `updated` - Time at which the object was last updated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `value_settings` - Fields that specify how to calculate a meter event's value. See [`value_settings`](#value_settings) below.

<a id="customer_mapping"></a>
### `customer_mapping`

The `customer_mapping` attribute supports:

* `event_payload_key` - The key in the meter event payload to use for mapping the event to a customer.
* `type` - The method for mapping a meter event to a customer. Possible values: `by_id`.

<a id="default_aggregation"></a>
### `default_aggregation`

The `default_aggregation` attribute supports:

* `formula` - Specifies how events are aggregated. Possible values: `count`, `last`, `sum`.

<a id="status_transitions"></a>
### `status_transitions`

The `status_transitions` attribute supports:

* `deactivated_at` - The time the meter was deactivated, if any. Measured in seconds since Unix epoch.

<a id="value_settings"></a>
### `value_settings`

The `value_settings` attribute supports:

* `event_payload_key` - The key in the meter event payload to use as the value for this meter.
